contests.title: Franklin Springs — senior city-tax homestead exemption

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Franklin Springs ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes for the full amount of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city who are 65 years of age or older?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Franklin Springs ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes for the full amount of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city who are 65 years of age or older?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Franklin Springs ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes for the full amount of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city who are 65 years of age or older?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Exempts the full assessed value of a qualifying homestead from Franklin Springs city property taxes, including city bond taxes, beginning January 1, 2027 if voters approve. The resident must be at least 65 on January 1 of the application year. It replaces other city-tax homestead exemptions and does not apply to state, county or school property taxes. The resident or an agent must apply to the city or its designee; the exemption then renews while the home remains the resident’s homestead, and recipients must report loss of eligibility.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the full city-tax homestead exemption for qualifying residents age 65 or older.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed city-tax homestead exemption.
